title: Контраст: Фон vs Длительность (Past Cont vs Past PerfCont)
description: Выбери правильную форму (Процесс в момент vs Процесс ДО момента).

items.question: At 5 PM I (was playing / had been playing) football.
I (was playing / had been playing) football for an hour when it started to rain.
When she came, we (were watching / had been watching) TV.
She (was reading / had been reading) a book at 5 PM.
They (were studying / had been studying) for 3 hours before the exam.
